verdict.rationale: Resend documents the pieces a first send needs: a send-email API reference, API key creation, an SMTP option, and domain add/verify via dashboard, API, CLI or MCP, so the required domain setup is not hidden. Community feedback praises idiomatic SDKs across many languages and a homepage code snippet, and a Vercel integration auto-creates an API key as an environment variable. However, the pack has no actual per-language quickstart page and no evidence of time-to-first-email. missing for 10: a documented copy-paste-complete quickstart per language, evidence of signup-to-delivered-email in minutes, hands-on corroboration that onboarding surfaces required setup such as domain verification.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first delivered email in minutes — the quickstart is copy-paste complete for my language and doesn't hide required setup
